objective: Test whether causally inferred unfinished parent-order slicing predicts the next same-side child packet and leaves repeatable after-cost residual markout large enough to justify exact quote/depth reconstruction before any official 2024 opening.

economic_mechanism.parent_order: A large trading intention split into repeated child orders to limit immediate market impact.
economic_mechanism.observable_state: Completed public-trade packets with jointly regular same-side timing and size, high side purity, sufficient sequence notional and non-exhausted directional response.
economic_mechanism.prediction: After the required completed packets, at least one additional same-side child packet and residual price pressure arrive after the decision timestamp.
economic_mechanism.ict_translation: Algorithmic institutional execution creates displacement and imbalance; the sequence state determines whether the parent order is still active. A surviving next stage enters only on the first causal retracement into the sequence displacement and invalidates on sequence cessation or opposing structural break.

non_overlap: Generic event-tape pace/control without timing-and-size repetition is excluded.
Fixed UTC quarter-hour or other wall-clock phase features are excluded.
L2 cancellation/refill, maker queues, OI, liquidation, cross-venue, wallet identity, options, premium, VWAP and completed-bar momentum are excluded.

data_contract.market: USDT linear perpetual public historical trades
data_contract.integrity: Downloaded gzip bytes, decompressed row count and SHA-256 are recorded.

causal_packet_contract.packet_definition: Consecutive trades sharing exchange timestamp, side and price are consolidated by summed size/notional. A packet is closed and becomes observable only when the next distinct trade is read.
causal_packet_contract.sequence_direction: The sign of the dominant completed packet side in the causal sequence.
causal_packet_contract.period_estimation: Median interval is estimated only from completed packets in the current sequence; no fixed clock period or time-of-day input is allowed.
causal_packet_contract.entry_mark: First observed trade at or after decision timestamp plus latency.
causal_packet_contract.next_slice_label: The first qualifying future packet inside two causal median sequence intervals, capped at 60 seconds; success requires the same side before an opposite-side qualifying packet.
causal_packet_contract.one_global_slot: Enforced independently for each candidate and markout horizon across BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT.

cost_and_execution_screen.funding: Not separately modeled over 10-300 second fatal-screen horizons.
cost_and_execution_screen.qualification: Sparse markout screen only. Any survivor requires exact BBO/depth, first-retracement execution, structural exits, risk sizing, funding and continuous NAV replay before rank eligibility.

conditional_next_stage.if_zero_survivors: Register reusable hard-valid negative evidence for this dependency, keep 2024-2026 sealed and move to a structurally different information/payoff source.
conditional_next_stage.if_one_or_more_survivors: Expand 2023 reconstruction, then freeze one family for exact-quote/depth first-retracement execution and sequential 2024 evaluation without tuning on 2024.

prohibitions: No 2024, 2025 or 2026 source opening in this workflow.
No same-packet, same-trade or pre-decision fill.
No parameter change after development outcomes are read.
No cumulative-ranking promotion from this sparse screen.
